title: fix(app-shell): Studio's draft panel and build history address a bundle member (?member=)
body:
Fixes #12271
Clause-②: no

Studio's pending-changes sheet and build history stop conflating two members of one bundle. Since objectstack-ai/objectstack#23073 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23099, `252a5821de`) each `GET /meta/_drafts` row and each touched item of `GET /packages/:id/commits` carries `member` for a type whose identity is a pair (today only `email_template`, `(name, locale)`), and the by-name `/meta` doors take it back as `?member=` (objectstack `038d4c958`). Key and presence rule read from the INSTALLED `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.1`: `member: z.string().optional()` on `ListDraftsResponseSchema.drafts[]` and on `ListPackageCommitsResponseSchema.commits[].items[]`, "present on every draft of such a type ... absent for a type whose identity is its name alone".

## What changed (`packages/app-shell/src/preview/`)

- `usePendingDrafts.ts` — `fetchPendingDrafts` copies `member` onto the entry when served (a non-empty string), and adds nothing otherwise.
- `DraftChangesPanel.tsx`
  - Each entry keeps `member`. Row identity (React key, expanded set, no-change set) is the JSON tuple of type, name and member (`entryKey`), so two members of one name are two rows.
  - `fetchItemBody` sends `member=` only when the entry carries one. The drill-in's published read and draft read both pass the entry's member. An entry without one sends no selector, never an empty one.
  - NEW / UPDATE for a member entry comes from that member's own published by-name read with `?member=`. The published NAME list says the name is published, which for `email_template` is true as soon as any one language is. Name-only entries keep the one list read per type.
  - The row shows the member beside the name (data, no new string).
- `commitHistory.ts` / `CommitTimeline.tsx` — `fetchCommits` keeps the touched items that carry `member` (`memberItems`). The timeline lists them as `type/name · member` under the commit. A commit whose items carry none renders exactly as before.

## Premise measurements (dispatch assumptions A1 to A3)

- A1, partly disproved: the panel has NO per-entry publish or discard action. Its by-name doors are the published read and the draft read (drill-in), plus the security-lint draft read. The lint reads `object` drafts only (`lintDraftSecurityPosture` filters `type === 'object'`), and an object never carries `member`, so that read is unchanged. Publishing belongs to the host: `usePublishAllDrafts` uses the package batch door, or `client.publishDraft(type, name)` for a package-less draft. Neither is in this file surface. See Acceptance notes.
- A2, held: row identity was the string type colon name. It now includes member.
- A3: no door the panel calls goes through `metadata-client.ts`. The panel uses its own `fetch` helpers in `preview/`, so that file is untouched.

## Tests

- New `DraftChangesPanel.bundleMember-12271.test.tsx` (5 cases):
  - two members of one `email_template` are two rows, each showing its member;
  - each member is classified through its own `?member=` read (zh-CN reads New although the name is in the published list);
  - expanding either member reads and diffs that member's own bodies, and never the canonical draft;
  - a name-only `object` entry sends no `member=` on any read.
- New `CommitTimeline.bundleMember-12271.test.tsx` (2 cases): the member list for two languages; nothing extra for a member-less commit.
- `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/preview/`: `Test Files 21 passed (21)`, `Tests 153 passed (153)` (under the verify lock, on the tree committed as `8b5b0b49c`).
- Ablation, one-off through `ablation-replace.mjs`:
  - Mutation: the `member=` push in `fetchItemBody` replaced (anchor 1 to 0, blob `cc71e34a1a44` to `5c7b08b83b38`).
  - Result: `Tests 3 failed | 4 passed (7)`. Red: the classification pin and both drill-in pins, the predicted direction. The row-identity pin and the timeline pins stay green, which they should.
  - Restore: blob == HEAD `cc71e34a1a44`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Gates (recorded exit codes, tree `8b5b0b49c`)

- 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- `eslint` narrowed to the 6 changed files: exit 0, 0 errors, 4 warnings.
  - The 4 warnings are the same count the base versions carry (2+1+1 at `28fb2a001`, read with `eslint --stdin` on the base blobs).
  - Type-aware linting is not enabled in `eslint.config.js`, so this diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file.
- NOT MEASURED: app-shell `type-check` (closure build) and the full app-shell vitest project. Reason: the shared verify lock was not acquired in three 9-minute waits. The holder ran a full `packages/app-shell/` run for over 30 minutes. Declared to CI.
- Ablation and the 7 new cases' green leg ran outside the lock with `--maxWorkers=1`. This is a declared narrowing.

## Acceptance notes

- **Package-less member publish.** `usePublishAllDrafts` (Home banner, draft-preview bar) still publishes a package-less draft by `client.publishDraft(type, name)`. The call chain is `usePublishAllDrafts`, then `useMetadataClient`, then `MetadataClient.publishDraft` in `packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`. That method takes no member, and the hook's own `listDrafts` mapping drops `member`. A package-less `zh-CN` draft would therefore publish the canonical member. Package-bound drafts go through the package batch door and are unaffected. Out of this card's file surface, and `metadata-client.ts` is held by objectui#12335. Carrier: objectui#12335 (the PR that touches `metadata-client.ts`).
- The member is shown as served (`zh-CN`), not as a language name, so no string was added.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
